offering_description.value: Puma Biotechnology sells an oral targeted therapy for certain patients with HER2-positive breast cancer through specialty pharmacies and distributors. It uses contract manufacturers, licenses commercialization rights to partners outside the United States, and develops investigational cancer therapies.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Specialty pharmacies, specialty drug distributors, and pharmaceutical commercialization partners

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription breast cancer drug sold through specialty channels; licensing or royalties: Commercialization rights and royalties on partner sales outside the United States

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops licensed drug candidates and supplies a contract-manufactured breast cancer therapy to specialty channels

geography_served.value: global: United States directly, with licensed partners in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: Targeted oncology drugs, with one marketed breast cancer therapy and investigational cancer treatments

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Specialty pharmacies dispensing oral oncology prescriptions; distributors / dealers: Specialty drug distributors supplying healthcare providers; partners / resellers: International pharmaceutical licensees
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription oncology drugs require FDA and overseas marketing approvals and compliance with clinical and manufacturing rules

notes: The current clinical development stages and full list of international markets are uncertain.
